page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core CPU capabilities, as evidenced by its high multi-core stress-ng performance and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression results. Memory performance is also strong for large-block read-only bandwidth, though write bandwidth and small-block cached reads remain in the average tier. The processor's extended instructions, including AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI, contribute to strong performance in PassMark extended instruction tests and database operations. However, text generation speeds for LLM inference on 135M and 7B models are weak, while prompt processing speeds fall into the average range.

Given its dedicated compute resources and high clock speed, the instance offers a balanced cost-to-performance profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for multi-threaded processing tasks, database operations, software compilation, and static web serving. The lack of bundled local storage means users must factor in external storage solutions for data-persistent workloads.
